LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_Random.label: Scavenge random loot
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_Random.description: Scavenge the dungeon, looting anything you can find until you cannot carry any more. Inventory fills up fast when looting all items. In terms of value gained per minute, this action is twice as efficient as searching for specific items. Produces random loot.
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_Random.jobString: Scavenging for anything at twice the efficiency.
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_Food.label: Scavenge for food
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_Food.description: Scavenge the dungeon for edible food while ignoring all other items.
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_BuildingMaterials.label: Scavenge for building materials
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_BuildingMaterials.descri: Scavenge the dungeon for building materials such as blocks, mineral ores, and wood logs.
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_CraftingMaterials.label: Scavenge for crafting materials
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_CraftingMaterials.descri: Scavenge the dungeon for crafting materials such as wool, leather, and mineral ores.
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_WeaponsAmmo.label: Scavenge for weapons and shells
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_WeaponsAmmo.description: Scavenge the dungeon for weapons and shells.
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_Apparel.label: Scavenge for apparel and armor
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_Apparel.description: Scavenge the dungeon for apparel and armor of any tech level.
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_Medical.label: Scavenge for medical items
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_Medical.description: Scavenge the dungeon for medical items such as neutroamine, medicine, implants, and artificial body parts.
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_Drugs.label: Scavenge for drugs
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_Rare.label: Scavenge for rare loot
LanguageData.ScavengeDungeon_Rare.description: Scavenge the dungeon for rare and valuable items that are difficult to obtain. Searching for rare items can take a long time.
